source_name: KBO/BCE Open Data (Crossroads Bank for Enterprises)
organization: FOD Economie / SPF Économie (Kruispuntbank van Ondernemingen / Banque-Carrefour des Entreprises)
license: Licence-BCE-Open-Data (reuse allowed; personal data NOT for direct marketing)
notes: FREE bulk CSV company master: full file (all active enterprises + establishment units) + daily update file. Free registration + terms acceptance (no payment); SFTP on request. Standard CSV set: enterprise/establishment/denomination/address/activity/contact/branch/code/meta. ~1.9M+ enterprises. The open spine. Keyed on EnterpriseNumber (= VAT root).

source_name: NBB Central Balance Sheet Office (annual accounts, XBRL)
organization: Nationale Bank van België / Banque Nationale de Belgique (NBB/BNB)
bulk_download_url: https://consult.cbso.nbb.be/ (per-entity); web services (Authentic Data Daily Extract)
license: Free to the public (Authentic Data); Improved Data paid; terms of use apply
data_freshness: annual filing; XBRL since 2007-04-02, CSV since 2022-04-04, PDF since 1999
notes: FREE structured annual accounts. ~99% filed in XBRL. CONSULT (consult.cbso.nbb.be) = free per-entity download (PDF since 1999, XBRL since 2007, CSV since 2022). Web services (developer.cbso.nbb.be, free account): Authentic Data Query + Daily Extract FREE; Improved Data paid. JSON-from-XBRL since 2022. Belgian GAAP schemas (micro/abbreviated/full). Among the best open structured-financials sources. Join on EnterpriseNumber.

source_name: KBO Public Search (web) + Public Search Web Service
license: Free web search; web service paid
notes: Free WEB search (no account; NL/FR/DE/EN) for single-company lookups. The Public Search WEB SERVICE API is PAID (~EUR 50 / 2000 requests). For bulk use the KBO Open Data instead. Free third-party REST mirrors (cbeapi.be etc.) exist with a free API key (401 without).

source_name: Free third-party CBE/KBO REST APIs (cbeapi.be, companybelgium, ...)
license: Per provider; underlying data = KBO open data (Licence-BCE-Open-Data)
notes: Convenience JSON REST over the KBO open data, free tier with an API key (verified 401 without a key). Useful for ad-hoc lookups; for ingestion use the official KBO Open Data bulk. Attribute the underlying KBO source.

license: Restricted (legitimate interest / authorities / obliged entities; fee)
notes: Beneficial-ownership register via MyMinfin. Restricted access (legitimate interest, fee; post-CJEU). Not open bulk. Noted for completeness.
National catalog; lists the KBO open data + NBB + regional datasets. Discovery hub; the primary sources above are the actual data.
Official gazette of company acts/publications (free search). Event/lifecycle source keyed on the enterprise number; not a bulk master.

source_name: Commercial aggregators (Companyweb, Trends Top, Bureau van Dijk/Bel-First, Graydon)
notes: Resell KBO + NBB data with scores/ratios/relationships. OPTIONAL — not required since the underlying registry (KBO) and financials (NBB XBRL) are free and open.
